# Assignment of database

```{r}
# Mit order und Übereinstimmung >70%
assign_taxonomy <- function(row) {
  dbs <- c("RDP/UNITE", "BOLD", "NCBI")  # Prioritätsreihenfolge
  
  for (db in dbs) {
    if (db == "RDP/UNITE") {
      percent_identity <- as.numeric(row$RDP_Species_Support)
      grade <- 1 #RDP hat kein Grade, daher wird 1 angenommen
      species <- row$RDP_Species
      genus <- row$RDP_Genus
      family <- row$RDP_Family
      order <- row$RDP_Order
      class <- row$RDP_Class
      phylum <- row$RDP_Phylum
      kingdom <- row$RDP_Kingdom
      
    } else if (db == "BOLD") {
      percent_identity <- as.numeric(row$BOLD_HIT.ID)
      grade <- as.numeric(row$BOLD_Grade.ID)
      species <- row$BOLD_Species
      genus <- row$BOLD_Genus
      family <- row$BOLD_Family
      order <- row$BOLD_Order
      class <- row$BOLD_Class
      phylum <- row$BOLD_Phylum
      kingdom <- "Fungi"  # BOLD hat kein explizites Kingdom
      
    } else if (db == "NCBI") {
      percent_identity <- as.numeric(row$NCBI_HIT.ID)
      grade <- as.numeric(row$NCBI_Grade.ID)
      species <- row$NCBI_Species
      genus <- row$NCBI_Genus
      family <- row$NCBI_Family
      order <- row$NCBI_Order
      class <- row$NCBI_Class
      phylum <- row$NCBI_Phylum
      kingdom <- "Fungi"  # NCBI hat kein explizites Kingdom
      
    } else {
      next
    }
    
    # --- Species-Level ---
    if (!is.na(percent_identity) && percent_identity >= 0.975 && grade > 0.7) {
      return(c(row$OTU_ID, percent_identity, grade, db, kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species))
    }
    
    # --- Genus-Level ---
    if (!is.na(percent_identity) && percent_identity >= 0.95 && percent_identity < 0.975 && grade > 0.7) {
      return(c(row$OTU_ID, percent_identity, grade, db, kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, ""))
    }
  }
  
  # --- Kein Treffer ---
  return(c(row$OTU_ID, NA, NA, "No match", "", "", "", "", "", "", ""))
}

df_cons <- as.data.frame(t(apply(kaefer, 1, function(r) assign_taxonomy(as.list(r)))))
colnames(df_cons) <- c("OTU_ID", "Percent_identity", "Grade", "db", 
                       "Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "GENUS", "Species")

# Keep only Kingdom=Fungi
df_cons <- df_cons %>%
  filter(Kingdom=="Fungi")
```

## General Setup

```{r}
# --- Käferarten & Familien definieren ---
beetle_lookup <- tribble(
  ~genus,                  ~species,                     ~family,
  "Rutpela",               "Rutpela_maculata",           "Cerambycidae",
  "Stenurella",            "Stenurella_melanura",        "Cerambycidae",
  "Anthaxia",              "Anthaxia_quadripunctata",    "Buprestidae",
  "Bolitophagus",          "Bolitophagus_reticulatus",   "Tenebrionidae",
  "Pachytodes",            "Pachytodes_cerambyciformis", "Cerambycidae",
  "Grammoptera",           "Grammoptera_ruficornis",     "Cerambycidae",
  "Ips",                   "Ips_typographus",            "Curculionidae"
)

# --- Alle Spaltennamen erzeugen (Individuen je Art) ---
beetle_cols <- grep(
  "Bolitophagus|Pachytodes|Grammoptera|Rutpela|Anthaxia|Stenurella|Ips",
  names(reads_traits),
  value = TRUE
)

  "Rutpela_maculata",
  "Stenurella_melanura",
  "Bolitophagus_reticulatus", # Tenebrionidae

)
```

# NMDS mit OTU_ID

```{r}
# 1) Nur OTU_ID + Beetle-Columns auswählen
otu_df <- reads_traits %>%
  select(OTU_ID, all_of(beetle_cols))

# 2) OTU_ID als Spaltennamen setzen
otu_matrix <- as.matrix(otu_df[, -1])   # alle Beetle columns
otu_matrix <- t(otu_matrix)             # Samples als Zeilen

# 3) Rownames = Beetle-Individual Namen
rownames(otu_matrix) <- colnames(otu_df)[-1]

# 4) Column names = OTU IDs
colnames(otu_matrix) <- otu_df$OTU_ID

# Kontrolle
dim(otu_matrix)
str(otu_matrix)

otu_df_animal <- reads_traits_animal %>%
  select(OTU_ID, all_of(beetle_cols))

# 2) OTU_ID als Spaltennamen setzen
otu_matrix_animal <- as.matrix(otu_df_animal[, -1])   # alle Beetle columns
otu_matrix_animal <- t(otu_matrix_animal)             # Samples als Zeilen

# 3) Rownames = Beetle-Individual Namen
rownames(otu_matrix_animal) <- colnames(otu_df_animal)[-1]

# 4) Column names = OTU IDs
colnames(otu_matrix_animal) <- otu_df_animal$OTU_ID

# Kontrolle
dim(otu_matrix_animal)
str(otu_matrix_animal)

```

## NMDS Plot

```{r, fig.width=12, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# ----------------------
# NMDS: All fungi
# ----------------------
t.otu <- as.data.frame(otu_matrix)

t.otu$group <- case_when(
  str_detect(rownames(t.otu), "Ips") ~ "Ips_typographus",
  str_detect(rownames(t.otu), "Bolitophagus") ~ "Bolitophagus_reticulatus",
  str_detect(rownames(t.otu), "Pachytodes") ~ "Pachytodes_cerambyciformis",
  str_detect(rownames(t.otu), "Grammoptera") ~ "Grammoptera_ruficornis",
  str_detect(rownames(t.otu), "Rutpela") ~ "Rutpela_maculata",
  str_detect(rownames(t.otu), "Anthaxia") ~ "Anthaxia_quadripunctata",
  str_detect(rownames(t.otu), "Stenurella") ~ "Stenurella_melanura",
  TRUE ~ "unbekannt"
)

t.otu$family <- case_when(
  str_detect(t.otu$group, "Ips") ~ "Curculionidae",
  str_detect(t.otu$group, "Bolitophagus") ~ "Tenebrionidae",
  str_detect(t.otu$group, "Pachytodes|Grammoptera|Rutpela|Stenurella") ~ "Cerambycidae",
  str_detect(t.otu$group, "Anthaxia") ~ "Buprestidae",
  TRUE ~ "unbekannt"
)

# NMDS
set.seed(123)
ord <- metaMDS(t.otu[, -c(ncol(t.otu), ncol(t.otu)-1)], distance = "bray")

nmds_scores <- data.frame(
  NMDS1 = ord$points[,1],
  NMDS2 = ord$points[,2],
  group = t.otu$group,
  family=t.otu$family
)

# ----------------------
# NMDS: Beetle-associated
# ----------------------
t.otu_animal <- as.data.frame(otu_matrix_animal)
t.otu_animal$group <- case_when(
  str_detect(rownames(t.otu_animal), "Ips") ~ "Ips_typographus",
  str_detect(rownames(t.otu_animal), "Bolitophagus") ~ "Bolitophagus_reticulatus",
  str_detect(rownames(t.otu_animal), "Pachytodes") ~ "Pachytodes_cerambyciformis",
  str_detect(rownames(t.otu_animal), "Grammoptera") ~ "Grammoptera_ruficornis",
  str_detect(rownames(t.otu_animal), "Rutpela") ~ "Rutpela_maculata",
  str_detect(rownames(t.otu_animal), "Anthaxia") ~ "Anthaxia_quadripunctata",
  str_detect(rownames(t.otu_animal), "Stenurella") ~ "Stenurella_melanura",
  TRUE ~ "unbekannt"
)

t.otu_animal$family <- case_when(
  str_detect(t.otu_animal$group, "Ips") ~ "Curculionidae",
  str_detect(t.otu_animal$group, "Bolitophagus") ~ "Tenebrionidae",
  str_detect(t.otu_animal$group, "Pachytodes|Grammoptera|Rutpela|Stenurella") ~ "Cerambycidae",
  str_detect(t.otu_animal$group, "Anthaxia") ~ "Buprestidae",
  TRUE ~ "unbekannt"
)
set.seed(123)
ord.animal <- metaMDS(t.otu_animal[, -c(ncol(t.otu_animal), ncol(t.otu_animal)-1)], distance = "bray")

nmds_scores.animal <- data.frame(
  NMDS1 = ord.animal$points[,1],
  NMDS2 = ord.animal$points[,2],
  group = t.otu_animal$group,
  family= t.otu_animal$family
)

# ----------------------
# Einheitliche Level-Reihenfolge basierend auf t.otu
# ----------------------
all_groups <- unique(t.otu$group)  # Reihenfolge wie in der OTU-Matrix
nmds_scores$group <- factor(nmds_scores$group, levels = all_groups)
nmds_scores.animal$group <- factor(nmds_scores.animal$group, levels = all_groups)

# ----------------------
# Gemeinsame Farbpalette
# ----------------------
cols <- pal_d3("category20")(length(all_groups))
names(cols) <- all_groups

# ----------------------
# Plots
# ----------------------
plot_all <- ggplot(nmds_scores, aes(NMDS1, NMDS2, color = group, shape = family)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.95) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols, drop = FALSE) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  labs(title = "NMDS (All fungi)",
      color = "Beetle Species",
      shape = "Beetle Family")+
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
    shape = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))   # <-- eine Reihe für die Shapes

plot_animal <- ggplot(nmds_scores.animal, aes(NMDS1, NMDS2, color = group, shape=family)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.95) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols, drop = FALSE) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  labs(title = "NMDS (animal-related)",
      color = "Beetle Species",
      shape = "Beetle Family")+
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
    shape = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE))

# ----------------------
# Kombinierter Plot mit gemeinsamer Legende
# ----------------------
combined_plot_NMDS <- (plot_all + plot_animal) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", widths = c(1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') &
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.justification = "left",
    legend.box.just = "left",        # sorgt dafür, dass ALLE Guides linksbündig angeordnet werden
    legend.text.align = 0,
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )


combined_plot_NMDS

ggsave("NMDS.png", plot = combined_plot_NMDS,
       width = 15, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg="white")
```

# PERMANOVA

```{r}
# Distanzmatrix aus den OTU-Daten berechnen
dist_matrix <- vegdist(t.otu[, -c(ncol(t.otu), ncol(t.otu)-1)], method = "bray")  # Bray-Curtis, Spalten Group und Family werden entfernt

# PERMANOVA durchführen
adonis_res <- adonis2(dist_matrix ~ group, data = t.otu)
adonis_res
100/22.381*10.072
# 0.001 *** → sehr signifikant, Unterschiede zwischen Gruppen sind statistisch signifikant
# 45% der Variation wird durch die Gruppenzugehörigkeit erklärt
```

```{r}
# Distanzmatrix aus den OTU-Daten berechnen
dist_matrix_animal <- vegdist(t.otu_animal[, -c(ncol(t.otu_animal), ncol(t.otu_animal)-1)], method = "bray")  # Bray-Curtis, Spalten Group und Family werden entfernt

# PERMANOVA durchführen
adonis_res_animal <- adonis2(dist_matrix_animal ~ group, data = t.otu_animal)
adonis_res_animal
100/21.94*10.199
# 0.001 *** → sehr signifikant, Unterschiede zwischen Gruppen sind statistisch signifikant
# 46% der Variation wird durch die Gruppenzugehörigkeit erklärt
```

# Multifactorial PERMANOVA

## Metadata beetles

```{r}
beetle_lookup <- tribble(
  ~genus,        ~species,                     ~family,        ~diet_type,          ~preferred_host,        ~adult_behavior,        ~habitat_type,
  "Rutpela",     "Rutpela_maculata",           "Cerambycidae", "wood_generalist",   "deciduous+conifer",   "stays_on_host",        "mixed_forest",
  "Stenurella",  "Stenurella_melanura",        "Cerambycidae", "wood_generalist",   "deciduous+conifer",   "visits_flowers",       "mixed_forest",
  "Anthaxia",    "Anthaxia_quadripunctata",    "Buprestidae",  "wood_specialist",   "conifer",             "stays_on_host",        "conifer_forest",
  "Bolitophagus","Bolitophagus_reticulatus",   "Tenebrionidae","fungus_specialist", "fungi",               "stays_on_host",        "fruiting_bodies_fungi",
  "Pachytodes",  "Pachytodes_cerambyciformis","Cerambycidae", "wood_generalist",   "deciduous+conifer",   "stays_on_host",        "mixed_forest",
  "Grammoptera", "Grammoptera_ruficornis",     "Cerambycidae", "wood_specialist",   "specific_deciduous",  "stays_on_host",        "deciduous_forest",
  "Ips",         "Ips_typographus",            "Curculionidae","bark_beetle",       "conifer",             "phloem_feeder",        "spruce_forest"
)



```

```{r}
sample_metadata <- data.frame(
  sample = rownames(otu_matrix)
) %>%
  # Extrahiere den Genus aus dem Sample-Namen
  mutate(genus = str_extract(sample, "Rutpela|Stenurella|Anthaxia|Bolitophagus|Pachytodes|Grammoptera|Ips")) %>%
  # Join mit beetle_lookup
  left_join(beetle_lookup %>%
              select(species, family, genus, diet_type, preferred_host, adult_behavior, habitat_type),
            by = "genus")

# 2) Distanzmatrix berechnen (Bray-Curtis)
# ----------------------
dist_matrix <- vegdist(otu_matrix, method = "bray")

# ----------------------
# 3) Multifaktorielle PERMANOVA
# ----------------------
family_diet <- adonis2(dist_matrix ~ family  + diet_type,
        data = sample_metadata, permutations = 999)


interaction <- adonis2(dist_matrix ~ family + diet_type, family*diet_type,
        data = sample_metadata,
        permutations = 999)

#Datensatz zwar klein, aber trotzdem signifikanter Effekt von diet_type.. allerdings family+diet type nicht höher als Faktor "species" (zusammen ca. 41%)

preferred_host <- adonis2(dist_matrix ~  preferred_host + family,
        data = sample_metadata,
        permutations = 999)

preferred_host
#Habitat_type erklärt viel Varianz, allerdings haben im DF die Arten auch alle spezielle Habitate, deswegen Effekt fast so groß wie Spezies-Effekt --> Mehr Daten nötig
```
